title: paullinia elegans subsp. neglecta
intro: Paullinia elegans subsp. neglecta, commonly known as the "Gutta Tree" or "Gutta Percha Tree", is a plant species native to the tropical regions of Asia. The health benefits of Paullinia elegans subsp. neglecta include its potential in reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, such as fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Paullinia elegans subsp. neglecta include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
